"""sdh-spot-check read, runs 6 (e, n = +3.2e12) and 7 (h, n = -1.2e12), D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw MR first,
then onset (sdh_onset on the Nyquist-valid record), a window/detrend stability sweep of the zero-padded 1/B FFT,
and the peak set against F_L, the tetralayer model (ABAB / ABCA) and the trilayer ABA overlay (adjacent-N)."""
import sys
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset
_mdl = Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models"
sys.path.insert(0, str(_mdl / "tetralayer_fs_count")); import fs_count_b0 as fm4
import importlib.util as _ilu
_sp = _ilu.spec_from_file_location("fs3", _mdl / "trilayer_fs_count" / "fs_count_b0.py"); fm3 = _ilu.module_from_spec(_sp); _sp.loader.exec_module(fm3)

FLt = lambda n12: abs(n12) * 1e16 * cst.h / (4 * cst.e)
SENS = 50e-6   # sr1 sensitivity both runs (5 kOhm FS at 10 nA)

def load_R(rid):
    r = run(rid); B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6   # sr0 = drain current, gain -1e6
    R = r.col("sr1_X") / I                                              # sr1 gain 1 (device card)
    o = np.argsort(B); return B[o], R[o], float(np.median(I)), r

def fft_zp(B, R, lo, hi, deg=5, pad=16):
    """bg poly in B (before 1/B), interpolate to uniform 1/B, Hann, zero-pad x16 (sdh_fft does not pad on its uniform-B path)."""
    m = (B >= lo) & (B <= hi); dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], deg), B[m])
    u = np.linspace(1 / hi, 1 / lo, 2048); x = 1 / B[m]; o = np.argsort(x); yi = np.interp(u, x[o], dR[o])
    return np.fft.rfftfreq(pad * u.size, u[1] - u[0]), np.abs(np.fft.rfft(yi * np.hanning(u.size), n=pad * u.size))

def peakstr(f, s, fmin=2.0, k=6):
    pk, _ = find_peaks(s, prominence=0.05 * s[f > fmin].max()); pk = sorted([p for p in pk if f[p] > fmin], key=lambda p: -s[p])[:k]
    ref = max(s[p] for p in pk); return ", ".join(f"{f[p]:.1f}({s[p]/ref:.2f})" for p in sorted(pk))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 8))
for row, (rid, n12, lo_valid, win) in enumerate([(6, 3.2, 0.85, (1.4, 7.3)), (7, -1.2, 0.30, (1.5, 8.0))]):
    B, R, Ib, r = load_R(rid)
    T = r.col("T_sample"); Ig = np.abs(np.r_[r.col("k_2400_tg_curr"), r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")])
    print(f"=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12, D = 0; F_L = {FLt(n12):.2f} T | I = {Ib*1e9:.2f} nA | R(0) = {R[B < 0.35].mean():.0f} Ohm, "
          f"R max {R.max():.0f} Ohm @ {B[np.argmax(R)]:.2f} T | peak |V|/FS = {np.abs(r.col('sr1_X')).max()/SENS:.2f} | "
          f"T {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K | max |I_gate| {Ig.max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    ab = fm4.abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)[1]; abm = fm4.abab_mstar(n12 * 1e16); ac = fm4.abca_fs(n12 * 1e16); acm = fm4.abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)[1]
    print("  model ABAB:", ", ".join(f"{f:.2f} T (m* {m:.3f})" for (f, _), (_, m) in zip(ab, abm)),
          f"| ABCA: {ac[4]:.2f} T ({ac[1]}, m* {acm:.3f})", end="")
    if n12 > 0: print(" | trilayer ABA:", ", ".join(f"{x[0]:.2f}" for x in fm3.aba_fs(n12 * 1e16)[1]), "T")
    else: print()
    # onset on the Nyquist-valid record (run 6: 50 mT steps below 1 T alias any F > 7.2 T below 0.85 T)
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=lo_valid, b_hi=win[1], r_full_scale=SENS / Ib); print(on.summary())
    print("  FFT stability (window x bg degree; zero-padded; peaks = F [T] (rel. amp)):")
    for lo, hi in ([(1.0, 7.3), (1.4, 7.3), (1.0, 3.0), (2.0, 7.3), (1.4, 5.5)] if rid == 6 else [(0.8, 8.0), (1.5, 8.0), (1.0, 4.0)]):
        for deg in (4, 5, 7):
            f, s = fft_zp(B, R, lo, hi, deg); print(f"    [{lo:.1f},{hi:.1f}] T deg {deg}, dF = {1/(1/lo-1/hi):.2f} T: {peakstr(f, s)}")
    # raw first
    ax[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[row, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[row, 0].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    ax[row, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0 (sr1 B_1-B_2)")
    m = (B >= win[0]) & (B <= win[1]); dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    ax[row, 1].plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.7); ax[row, 1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[row, 1].set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm), bg5 in B")
    ax[row, 1].set_title(f"background-subtracted, B in [{win[0]}, {win[1]}] T")
    f, s = fft_zp(B, R, *win); ax[row, 2].plot(f, s / s[f > 2].max(), "k", lw=1, label=f"FFT [{win[0]},{win[1]}] T")
    ax[row, 2].axvline(FLt(n12), color="C0", ls="--", label="F_L (scale 1)")
    for i, (fa, _) in enumerate(ab): ax[row, 2].axvline(fa, color="C3", ls=":", label="ABAB model" if i == 0 else None)
    ax[row, 2].axvline(ac[4], color="C2", ls="-.", lw=0.8, label="ABCA model")
    if rid == 6:
        for k in (2, 3, 4, 8): ax[row, 2].axvline(k * 7.35, color="0.6", lw=0.6, ls="-", label="k x 7.35 T" if k == 2 else None)
    ax[row, 2].set_xlim(0, 2 * FLt(n12) if rid == 6 else 3 * FLt(n12)); ax[row, 2].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[row, 2].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`)

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti e-side D=0: n 2.40-3.24e12 x22 (0.04), B 0.85-6.0 T x123 uniform 1/B (Nyquist 60 T), fast 1.8 s / slow 3 s, sr1 50 uV; ends 6 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~08:09** (≈2h40m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (ana, runs 6–7) put the fan on the electron side: the hole side is capped at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² in the near-CNP exception regime. At n = +3.2×10¹² the peak set is a comb at k × 7.35 T. The 7.35 T tone sits on the ABAB light orbit. The ≈ 29.4 T tone is 4 × 7.35 exactly, so it could be a harmonic, the ABAB heavy tone (the pair sums to 1.11·F_L), or an ABCA / region-B tone. One density can't split these. The n-dependence does, and it is what this fan buys:
- a harmonic tracks 4·f_light(n), about 12.5 T per 10¹²;
- the ABAB heavy tone runs about 7.2 T per 10¹² with a light partner closing the Luttinger sum under one global scale;
- an ABCA singleton runs about 10.3·s T per 10¹² with no partner;
- region B shows as an intercept offset (n + 0.43), not a slope change.

Over the window below, these trajectories separate by ≥ 2.4 δF.

**Design (cost floor, per `landau-fan` step 1).**
- **B_lo = 0.85 T.** This is `sdh_onset` on run 6's Nyquist-valid record. The light tone is censored there, so 0.85 T is a lower bound, not a guess.
- **n = 2.40 → 3.24×10¹².** The top end is the D = 0 line's TG-limit edge (V_tg 0.995 V). The bottom end is where the light partner still gets ≈ 5 periods in [0.85, 6] T (model 4.8 T at 2.4).
- **Coverage trade:** n < 2.4 is excluded. The partner is unresolvable there at this onset, and the heavy-vs-ABCA split falls below 2δF. The hole side is excluded for the reason above.
- **B_hi = 6 T.** Heavy-tone δF = 1.8–2.5 T (onset 1.4–1.75 T), and there is a high-B half for the breakdown / F_L-origin B-window split. Above ~6 T the low-n columns enter the QH regime.
- **Nyquist, B axis:** uniform in 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.00828 T⁻¹ gives a 60 T Nyquist. That clears F_max ≈ 40 T at 1/3 sampling, and the observed 58.5 T harmonic doesn't fold. A 1/2-rate grid would alias it onto the 22 T tone. 123 rows.
- **Nyquist, n axis:** ray spacing at 0.85 T is 0.082×10¹². A 0.04 step gives 2.06 points per period, which is the floor. 22 points.
- **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ 0.3 s, 24 dB, read and asserted). Each B row is fully settled by the ramp, 3 s settle and slow_delay 3 s. The n-axis lag only mixes neighbouring columns about 0.4 T apart in F, far below δF.
- **Sensitivity:** sr1 is set to 50 µV (5 kΩ full scale) and held fixed. The worst corner, n = 2.4 × 6 T, is about 0.7–0.9 kΩ, so headroom is ≥ 5×. sr1 is at 2 µV after the handoff restore and would rail without this set.
- **Price:** 22 × 1.95 s per point (run-5 overhead + paired set) + 7.5 s row overhead = 50 s per row. That's 103 min of rows, plus 38 min of bare ramp 0.85 → 6 T, plus 6 min positioning. Total 147 min, ≈ 2 h 40 m realistic.

**Ends at 6 T** with the gates parked at 0. The next step (LK mass split / firming) rides the field down instead of re-traversing.

**Checkpoints.**
1. **First rows (~8 min):** sr1 level vs full scale, I ≈ 10 nA, gate current, T, no flat channel. Abort there if anything's off.
2. **B ≈ 1.6 T (row 66, ~67 min):** per-column FFT on [0.85, 1.6] for light-tone presence across n. Abandoning here saves ~1 h 30 m (rail, leak, dead channel or featureless only; the heavy band lives above 1.4 T).
3. **B ≈ 3 T (row 101, ~1 h 47 m):** interim trajectories, light vs heavy vs 4× light.

Leak guard: > 1 nA on either gate interrupts the sweep and parks the gates.

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, per `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4) ===
# Per-column SdH-FFT fan: B slow, uniform in 1/B, 0.85 -> 6.0 T (123 rows, d(1/B) = 0.00828 -> Nyquist 60 T);
# n fast, paired (Vtg, Vbg) line at D = 0, n = 2.40 -> 3.24e12 (22 pts, 0.04e12). Ends at 6 T, gates parked at 0.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior; same as runs 6/7) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
ns = np.linspace(2.40, 3.24, 22)                                  # fast axis, 1e12 cm^-2
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs), np.asarray(Vbgs)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_nchk, ns) and np.allclose(_Dchk, D0, atol=1e-9)
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.85, 6.0, 123
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)                                # ascending (magnet sits at ~0 T)
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
SLOW_DELAY, FAST_DELAY = 3.0, 1.8                                 # 10 tau after flyback / 6 tau per n-point
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"fan: n {ns[0]:.2f}->{ns[-1]:.2f}e12 ({len(ns)} pts), Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f}; "
      f"B {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B) {(1/B_LO-1/B_HI)/(N_B-1):.5f})")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set): print expected vs actual, stop on mismatch ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_amp, _f, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5) | B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05) | V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0) | "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0) | PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()} out {magnet.output_enabled()} | "
      f"nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1) | drive {_amp} V @ {_f:.3f} Hz (1.0 @ 13.777) | tau {_tau} s / {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24) | "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V (>= 0.02)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not near 0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater is on"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(_f - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed (I_bias assumed 10 nA)"
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-9 and _slope == 24, "lock-in tau/slope differ from what the dwell was priced against"
assert sr0.sensitivity() >= 0.02, "sr0 sensitivity would rail the 10 mV drain signal"

# --- station first (a setup error costs nothing: no instrument has moved yet) ---
mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron D=0: n {ns[0]:.2f}->{ns[-1]:.2f}e12 x{len(ns)}, B {B_LO}->{B_HI} T x{N_B} uniform 1/B, "
                  f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV, run-5 cal")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4 fan, electron side: D = {D0} V/nm, n = {ns[0]:.2f} to {ns[-1]:.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({len(ns)} pts, 0.04e12); '
              f'B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T, {N_B} rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) {(1/B_LO-1/B_HI)/(N_B-1):.5f} 1/T, Nyquist 60 T); '
              f'fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (6 tau), slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; sr1 50 uV (5 kOhm FS); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; inherits spot check run 6')
# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner n = 2.4 x 6 T:
# R(0) 66 Ohm (run 5) x MR ~10-13 (run 6) ~ 0.7-0.9 kOhm -> >= 5x headroom. sr1 sat at 2 uV after the handoff restore.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS) | sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V | tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

# --- position: gates to the row start, then the magnet (blocking, ~6 min 0 -> 0.85 T) ---
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # field stays where the fan ended (6 T unless interrupted) — the next step rides it down; gates park at 0.
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"end: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")
